level_curve_note: Front-loaded HP and Strength let warriors anchor chokes from level 1; mid-game points shift toward Vitality and Mind for resistance caps.
playstyle: Hold narrow bridges and doorways behind heavy plate and shield walls, interrupting enemy casters while mercenaries flank.

level_curve_note: High Dexterity scales accuracy and critical strikes rapidly through Act II; invest in Mind by Act III to sustain volley cooldowns.
playstyle: Control sightlines from ridges and flanks, crippling advancing brutes with snares and sniping enemy hexers before lines collide.

level_curve_note: Starts fragile with tight mana pools, scaling sharply once Mind unlocks multi-target elemental combos and high-tier spell tomes.
playstyle: Shape the battlefield with timed AoE bursts, frost slows, and wards while keeping hired shield-bearers between robes and blades.

level_curve_note: Steady hybrid scaling balances Mind for minion capacity and curses with Vitality to survive blood-tithes and attrition fights.
playstyle: Audit the battlefield through patient attrition—bind fallen foes as bone shields, compound curses on elites, and siphon vigor.
